description:
Context: .github/workflows/publish.yml installs floating npm@11 instead of an exact 11.x version (#871), and .claude/release-profile.md, docs/RELEASING.md, and scripts/release.mjs claim core-first publish order and --access public while findPublishMetadataProblems does not gate publishConfig.access=public (#873).
Requirements:
1. Pin an exact npm 11.x version (npm@11.11.0) with --ignore-scripts in .github/workflows/publish.yml (#871).
2. Update .claude/release-profile.md, docs/RELEASING.md, and scripts/release.mjs comments to state that publish order is topological over internal runtime dependencies and public access comes from publishConfig.access=public (no --access flag) (#873).
3. Extend findPublishMetadataProblems() in scripts/release.mjs to require publishConfig.access === "public" on every non-private publish target (#873).
4. Add regression tests in scripts/test/release.test.mjs.
title: fix(release): pin exact npm@11 version in publish.yml, gate publishConfig.access=public, and fix release docs (#871, #873)
